### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: Confine subjective entries strictly to symptoms and history *reported by the patient*. Do not include provider observations or physical exam findings.
[O-Section]: Report objective findings (e.g., vital signs, physical exam results) as raw data. Avoid interpretive statements or evaluations (e.g., 'within normal limits') unless explicitly stated by the provider.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[O-Section]: When reporting objective findings, strictly adhere to the exact values and units provided in the transcript. Do not perform unit conversions.
[A/P-Section]: Ensure all referrals and management plans are attributed to the specific conditions or reasons explicitly stated by the provider. Do not infer additional scope or conditions for a referral.

### ITERATION 3 CONSTRAINTS
[O-Section]: Report all numerical values and their units *exactly* as stated in the transcript. Under no circumstances perform unit conversions (e.g., Fahrenheit to Celsius, lbs to kg).
